faqs.q: How to spot deepfake videos in 2026?
faqs.a: In 2026, spotting deepfakes requires looking for microscopic texture inconsistencies and the 'diffusion hum'—a specific frequency pattern found in generative synthesis. ScanDeepFake automates this forensic deep-scan.

faqs.q: Free AI image integrity check: Is it reliable?
faqs.a: Yes, our ScanDeepFake free-tier uses advanced neural fingerprints to verify image integrity. While no tool is 100% infallible, our system provides a 99.8% precision score on standard generative models.

faqs.q: Detecting AI face swap online effortlessly.
faqs.a: Using our simplified 5-step workflow, you can drop any image or video to perform an instant face-swap detection. We analyze orbital integrity and pixel variance to find even subtle swaps.

faqs.q: What are the signs of a manipulated AI image?
faqs.a: Look for non-linear shadows, irregular textures in hair or fabric, and perfect geometric symmetry which rarely exists in nature. AI often fails to render lighting that matches the entire scene consistently.

faqs.q: Can deepfakes be detected with 100% accuracy?
faqs.a: No forensic tool can claim 100% accuracy because generative technology evolves daily. However, by combining multiple forensic layers (Pixel, Frequency, Temporal), we can identify almost all current synthetic media.

faqs.q: Does ScanDeepFake work on WhatsApp, Telegram or Instagram videos?
faqs.a: Yes. You can download the video from WhatsApp, Telegram, or Instagram and upload it directly. We support common mobile formats (MP4, MOV, WebM). For best results, use the original file instead of a heavily compressed screenshot or screen recording.

faqs.q: Can it detect face-swap deepfakes in live video calls?
faqs.a: It can analyze a recorded video of the call. Live real-time detection during an ongoing call is not supported yet. The best protection against live deepfake calls is still to hang up and call back on a known number.

No tool is 100% accurate. ScanDeepFake gives a probability score based on multiple forensic signals (frequency artifacts, facial geometry, lighting consistency, etc.). Treat the result as strong evidence, not absolute proof, and always combine it with source verification.

faqs.q: Do you store or use my uploaded photos/videos for AI training?
faqs.a: No. Media is processed in temporary (ephemeral) cloud instances and permanently deleted immediately after analysis. We never store your files, never sell them, and never use them to train our models.

faqs.q: Can it detect AI-generated images from Midjourney, Flux, ChatGPT, or Sora?
faqs.a: Yes. Our engine is trained against modern diffusion models and face-swap techniques. Accuracy is higher on original files and lower on heavily compressed or screenshotted versions.

faqs.q: What file types and size limits do you support?
faqs.a: We currently support common image formats (JPG, PNG, WebP) and video formats (MP4, MOV, WebM). Maximum recommended size is 50 MB for smooth analysis. Larger files may take longer or fail.

faqs.q: Why does a real photo sometimes get flagged as AI?
faqs.a: False positives can happen with heavily edited, filtered, upscaled, or studio-lit photos. If you believe the result is wrong, try uploading the original unedited file and cross-check with another detector or the original source.

faqs.q: Can I check a video by pasting a YouTube or TikTok link?
faqs.a: Currently we only support direct file upload. Link/URL analysis is planned for a future update. For now, download the video and upload the file.

faqs.q: How is ScanDeepFake different from free tools like Hive or AI or Not?
faqs.a: Most free tools give only a single score. We combine multiple forensic methods (frequency domain, geometry, lighting, and temporal consistency) and focus on zero-retention privacy. We also explain the signals instead of just giving a yes/no.

faqs.q: What should I do if the tool says a video is likely a deepfake?
faqs.a:
• Do not share or act on it immediately.
• Check the original source (verified accounts, news outlets).
• Reverse-search key frames.
• If it's a financial or emergency request, hang up and verify through another channel.

faqs.q: Does compression or screenshotting reduce detection accuracy?
faqs.a: Yes. Heavy compression, re-encoding, and screenshots remove many forensic traces. Always try to use the highest quality original file available for better results.
Basic scanning is free and does not require an account. We may introduce optional paid features later (batch analysis, API, detailed reports), but the core free scanner will remain available.

legal.privacy:
Our commitment to your privacy is absolute. ScanDeepFake is built on strict zero-retention principles.

1. Ephemeral Cloud Processing & Immediate Deletion: User photos and videos are processed exclusively in isolated, ephemeral (temporary) cloud instances solely to run forensic analysis. Every file is permanently deleted immediately after your results are generated.
2. Zero Permanent Storage: We never store your uploaded photos or videos permanently on any server or database.
3. No Sale of Media: We never sell, rent, or share user photos or videos with third parties.
4. Never Used for AI Training: We never use your uploaded media to train, fine-tune, or improve our AI models.
5. Anonymized Usage Metrics: We collect only anonymized usage metrics (containing zero media content or personally identifiable information) to monitor uptime and improve system performance.
6. Cookies & Advertising: Minimal browser cookies may be used for interface preferences and Google AdSense delivery. You may opt out or clear cookies anytime in your browser settings.
